subject: Temporary proxy handoff for EU region — action & verification
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Aanya Patel <aanya@bluewave.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Temporary proxy handoff for EU region — action & verification

Hi Aanya,

We observed a material degradation affecting EU-west peering via our cloud provider that started ~14:30 UTC. For affected BlueWave tenants we are initiating a temporary proxy handoff to our EU-sidecar cluster to preserve latency and reduce 503s while the provider works the underlying peering flap.

Planned steps (summary):
- 15:30 UTC: enable auto-fallback for BlueWave tenant (opt-in required)
- 15:35 UTC: switch read traffic to EU sidecar proxies (no model changes)
- 15:40 UTC: run smoke tests (see runbook link + checklist attached)
- 16:30 UTC: monitor and keep you updated; rollback if we see regressions

What we need from you: concise confirmation that BlueWave Ops will run the 3 smoke checks in the PDF within 15 minutes of the cutover and a quick ack when you see request latencies below 300ms (p50) for the test endpoints.

Attachments: region-proxy-handshake-checklist.pdf, service-affinity-map-20270630.csv

Runbook: https://drive.redwood.ai/s/region-proxy-handshake-runbook

I will CC Priya and Ben for any contract/SLA questions and to coordinate billing/telemetry while the proxy is active.

Thanks — we’ll stand by and coordinate the window.

—
Grace O'Connor
Senior Customer Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Aanya Patel <aanya@bluewave.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: BlueWave Ops <ops@bluewave.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 15:21:10 +0000
Subject: Re: Temporary proxy handoff for EU region — action & verification

Grace — thanks for the heads up.

BlueWave Ops will run the three smoke checks and confirm. We can be ready for the 15:30 UTC opt-in; please proceed and notify when you flip traffic.

Quick question: will the sidecar handoff alter our token billing or only the egress path? We want to make sure finance is not surprised for a large traffic spike.

—
Aanya
Head of Platform, BlueWave Analytics
aanya@bluewave.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aanya Patel <aanya@bluewave.ai>, BlueWave Ops <ops@bluewave.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 15:31:45 +0000
Subject: Re: Temporary proxy handoff for EU region — action & verification

Grace / Priya — FYI and quick cost note for BlueWave: the temporary sidecar routing will not change token billing; customers are billed per-token as usual. There could be a small egress delta depending on path; for BlueWave’s traffic profile I estimate under 1.8% extra network egress cost for the window (ballpark).

Priya: please capture the interval in billing events and mark the invoice with the incident tag HUBSPOT-12098 for reconciliation.

Grace: once Aanya confirms the smoke checks, proceed with the opt-in. I will standby for any credit or SLA asks.

—
Ben Carter
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Aanya Patel <aanya@bluewave.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 17:03:02 +0000
Subject: Re: Temporary proxy handoff for EU region — action & verification

Aanya — appreciate the quick turnaround and confirmation from BlueWave Ops.

We completed the proxy handoff at 15:33 UTC and ran the checklist; BlueWave test endpoints p50 latency dropped to ~190ms and error rate fell to <0.2% within five minutes. Logs are attached and we left the fallback policy in place for up to 6 hours while the provider completes peering fixes.

Attached: region-proxy-handshake-checklist.pdf (completed), service-affinity-map-20270630.csv

Next steps:
- We will keep the fallback for up to 6 hours and provide a mid-window update at 17:30 UTC.
- If you see any anomalies please file them with subject line "BlueWave EU proxy handoff" and include timestamped request ids.
- After provider confirms peering stability we will coordinate a controlled revert and a short postmortem with timeline and root cause analysis.

Thanks again — standing by for any telemetry you want pulled.

—
Grace O'Connor
Senior Customer Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference
